messages:
maria: quick follow-up on onboarding: propose an admit_score (0-100) computed from perf/correctness/compat weights. defaults: perf=40, correctness=40, compat=20.

tom: sounds good. store score_breakdown so reviewers see per-check contributions. no opaque heuristics.

sree: add a tiny docker-lite repro runner in the minimal bundle so Console can 'replay locally' without fetching big binaries. runner must be deterministic.

alex: storage default: keep pointers + minimal repro (prompt, token_ids, seed, fingerprint). pointers must reference immutable objects (S3 version or dedup id) and include checksum.

jen: telemetry mapping: regression -> persist bundle + alert; transient infra -> retry 3x ephemeral; invariant-break -> quarantine + manual signoff. thresholds configurable per org.

sam: action items: maria draft RFC addendum with sample JSONs (due Thu), tom+sree prototype runner (PR next week), alex cost estimate pointer vs persist-binaries (by Fri), jen telemetry spec (next Wed).

maria: thanks all, i'll draft and ping for review. :white_check_mark:
